title: Risk & Controls Manager - Fixed Term
description: Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv. We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv. Job Title Risk & Controls Manager - Fixed Term Contract: Fixed-term role until September 2027 As Manager, Risk & Compliance , you will help strengthen and harmonise the risk and compliance environment by carrying out a gap analysis of existing controls and supporting the implementation of an enhanced Group model. This role will focus on building and embedding a risk and compliance framework aligned to regulatory requirements, monitoring and testing programmes, and consistent execution across the business. What you will do Complete a gap analysis of the existing controls, with a view to implementing an enhanced Group model Lead the build-out, harmonisation and embedding of risk and compliance frameworks aligned to regulatory requirements and monitoring and testing programmes Enhance the reporting suite to support monitoring, governance and escalation Work closely with first line teams to embed controls into processes, including customer care, merchant onboarding, system readiness and AMLA requirements Support training, documentation and consistent execution of the framework across the business Escalate matters to the Head of EMEA Risk and Compliance and other senior stakeholders where required What you will need to have Strong technical expertise in operational risk and control frameworks within payments and/or financial services Deep experience in RCSA, control design, process mapping, and governance, risk and compliance systems Familiarity with EU regulatory expectations, including safeguarding, AMLA, AML, outsourcing and DORA Ability to work hands-on in complex, multi-stream programmes with high interdependencies What would be great to have Experience supporting implementation of a Group-wide risk and control framework and/or harmonising local practices to enterprise standards Experience developing reporting, dashboards or management information for risk and control monitoring and escalation Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv. Please: Apply using your legal name Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable). Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law. Note to agencies: Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. title: Blockchain Risk Control Lead
description: Headquarters: Europe - Remote About Us Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance. Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution. Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services. Job Brief We are expanding our focus to cover AI-augmented threat intelligence and post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) security. The ideal candidate will combine deep blockchain forensics expertise with working knowledge of machine learning techniques for anomaly detection, and awareness of quantum computing threats to current cryptographic foundations (ECDSA, RSA) used across blockchain ecosystems. We value candidates who can bridge academia and industry and build collaborative relationships with research institutions to accelerate the adoption of emerging cryptographic and AI-driven techniques within the company. Main Responsibilities of a Blockchain Risk Control Analyst/Researcher Your main responsibilities will include: Leveraging LLM techniques to drive the development of next-generation on-chain risk identification and threat intelligence systems, including autonomous agent workflows capable of continuous monitoring, self-triggered investigation, and automated operational responses — reducing manual intervention across the full risk lifecycle from detection to resolution; Leading forensic investigations on real crypto theft, fraud, and market manipulation cases, integrating AI-assisted pattern recognition to accelerate root cause analysis; Researching post-quantum cryptographic algorithms (NIST PQC: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and their implications for blockchain security; assessing quantum computing threats to existing cryptographic foundations (ECDSA secp256k1, hash functions) and evaluating migration paths; Partnering with internal teams and external stakeholders for incident response, and engaging with academic institutions to translate frontier research into deployable security tools; Key Requirements You have a Master's or PhD's degree in Blockchain security, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. You are good at programming languages commonly used in blockchain analytics (e.g., SQL, Python, Javascript) Experience applying machine learning or AI techniques to blockchain data analysis, fraud detection, or threat intelligence A strong publication record in top-level industry or academic conferences is highly valued. You have experience with blockchain monitoring/forensic tools and analytics platforms. Familiarity with NIST PQC standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and lattice/hash-based cryptography fundamentals is a plus; Understanding of quantum computing threats to elliptic curve cryptography and implications for key management in Web3; You have security or risk control experience as a plus. You possess effective communication and collaboration abilities. English is essential, and proficiency in Mandarin can be an advantage. Why Join Us At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. Our benefits include: - Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning. - Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation. - Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world. - Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company. - Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bybit-blockchain-risk-control-lead
